source.existing_failure_acceptance_change_expli: An offscreen failure with unchanged action gives no visible outcome. Preserve body/control/focus/disclosure; permit only the dialog scroll required to reveal the existing status. Confirmed outcomes retain their reading. Timeout retains occupied space.
source.initial_candidate_correction: Keep truthful confirmed status after newer focus; guard only failure visibility scroll by the action's history signature. Measure nested Save reading at callback entry after locale clamping.

limits: Native isolated historical/synthetic fixtures only; no hosted or public-route production acceptance.
Two existing test functions have explicit scoped updates: visible failure feedback and actual nested-action starting scroll. Their originals are recoverable from the transforms.
Confirmed outcomes keep their reading; owned failures may move the existing drawer only enough to reveal actionable feedback while preserving body and focus.
Retaining the hidden message box prevents timeout-induced clamping; it does not guarantee constant geometry across differently sized later messages.
Existing status/live markup is retained; native browser checks are not assistive-technology announcement certification.
No storage retry, independent scroll container, status node, timer or history owner is introduced.
